# Noto Sans Arabic

The regular face of Noto Sans Arabic 2.013 (https://github.com/notofonts/arabic, release `NotoSansArabic-v2.013`, `NotoSansArabic/unhinted/ttf/NotoSansArabic-Regular.ttf`), unmodified. SHA-256:

- `NotoSansArabic-Regular.ttf`: `bd86ca02f087d7f3c3788ba458fb6b73744c7639ed276b8d870dba6def6c40d0`

Licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`OFL.txt`); authors in `AUTHORS.txt`.

Krystal.Booey embeds it as the fallback for Arabic (`codegen/bundled_fonts.py`), after Liberation Sans and before STIX Two Math.
